description.en: Automatically shows what you're watching on Hami Video — movies, TV series, anime, documentaries, kids' content, variety shows, and live or replayed sports.
description.zh-TW: 自動顯示您正在 Hami Video 觀看的內容，包含電影、影集、動漫、紀錄片、兒童內容、綜藝節目，以及運動賽事直播或重播。

settings.title: Privacy Mode
settings.description: Hide titles, episode info, poster art, and buttons — only shows that you're watching something

settings.title: Show Title
settings.description: Show the movie or series title

settings.title: Show Episode Title
settings.description: Show the episode's own title, if available

settings.title: Show Live Badge
settings.description: Show a LIVE badge as the small image during live broadcasts

settings.title: Show Buttons
settings.description: Show the "Watch on Hami Video" button

settings.title: Show Pause State
settings.description: Update the presence to show "Paused" when playback is paused
